question.text: With the introduction of direct payout of securities by CCs, the timing for securities payout has been revised to:

explanation.text: The Logic: Following the SEBI-mandated direct payout of securities by Clearing Corporations, the securities payout timing has been revised from 1:30 PM to 3:30 PM. The Trap: The direction of the change matters: payout timing moved later (1:30 PM to 3:30 PM), not earlier; the other times listed are not the revised payout time. Note: The revised 3:30 PM timing is the source-backed value tied to the introduction of direct payout to client demat accounts.
